contacts.create.title: Create Contact
contacts.create.description: Create a new contact in Brevo by email, optionally setting name, list memberships, and custom attributes.

email.description: Contact email address. Required and used as the unique identifier.

listIds.description: IDs of the Brevo lists to add the contact to.

attributes.description: Custom contact attributes as key-value pairs.

contacts.get.title: Get Contact
contacts.get.description: Retrieve a Brevo contact by email address or numeric contact ID.

identifier.description: The contact's email address or numeric Brevo contact ID.

identifier_type.description: Identifier family. Omit for email or numeric contact ID; required for ext_id, phone_id, whatsapp_id, and landline_number_id.

identifierType.description: Identifier family. Omit for email or numeric contact ID; required for ext_id, phone_id, whatsapp_id, and landline_number_id.

contacts.update.title: Update Contact
contacts.update.description: Update an existing Brevo contact's name, attributes, or list memberships by email or contact ID.

identifier.description: The contact's email address or numeric Brevo contact ID.

firstName.description: New first name for the contact.

lastName.description: New last name for the contact.

attributes.description: Custom contact attributes to update as key-value pairs.

listIds.description: List IDs to assign the contact to.

ext_id.description: New caller-owned external identifier for the contact.

list_ids.description: Brevo list IDs to add to the contact.

unlink_list_ids.description: Brevo list IDs to remove from the contact.

identifier_type.description: Identifier family. Omit for email or numeric contact ID; required for ext_id, phone_id, whatsapp_id, and landline_number_id.

sms_blacklisted.description: Set true to block SMS campaigns for this contact.

email_blacklisted.description: Set true to block email campaigns for this contact.

smtp_blacklist_sender.description: Transactional sender addresses forbidden for this contact.

contacts.delete.title: Delete Contact
contacts.delete.description: Permanently delete a Brevo contact by email address or numeric contact ID.

identifier.description: The contact's email address or numeric Brevo contact ID.

identifier_type.description: Identifier family. Omit for email or numeric contact ID; required for ext_id, phone_id, whatsapp_id, and landline_number_id.

identifierType.description: Identifier family. Omit for email or numeric contact ID; required for ext_id, phone_id, whatsapp_id, and landline_number_id.

smtp.email.send.title: Send Transactional Email
smtp.email.send.description: Send a transactional email via Brevo's SMTP API. If you omit the sender, the account's first verified sender is used automatically (a send from an unverified sender is silently dropped by Brevo). Supports HTML and plain-text content, CC/BCC, and reply-to.

sample.subject: Test email from appcall ✅
sample.htmlContent:
Hello 👋

This is a test email sent from the appcall guided tester. If you're reading this, sending works.

to.description: List of recipient email addresses (and optional display names).

sender.description: Sender. Optional — leave blank to use your account's first verified Brevo sender (recommended for testing).

lists.create.title: Create List
lists.create.description: Create a new contact list in Brevo under the specified folder.

name.description: Name of the new contact list.

folderId.description: ID of the folder to create the list in.

lists.get.title: Get List
lists.get.description: Retrieve details of a Brevo contact list by its numeric list ID.

listId.description: The numeric ID of the Brevo list to retrieve.

list_id.description: Positive numeric ID of the contact list.

start_date.description: Start of the campaign-statistics range as an ISO 8601 date or date-time.

end_date.description: End of the campaign-statistics range as an ISO 8601 date or date-time.

contacts.addToList.title: Add Contacts to List
contacts.addToList.description: Add one or more contacts (by email) to a Brevo contact list.

listId.description: The numeric ID of the Brevo list to add contacts to.

emails.description: Array of email addresses to add to the list.

contacts.removeFromList.title: Remove Contacts from List
contacts.removeFromList.description: Remove one or more contacts (by email) from a Brevo contact list, or remove all contacts.

listId.description: The numeric ID of the Brevo list to remove contacts from.

emails.description: Array of email addresses to remove from the list. Provide either this or all:true.

all.description: Set to true to remove all contacts from the list.

emailCampaigns.create.title: Create Email Campaign
emailCampaigns.create.description: Create a new email marketing campaign in Brevo with subject, sender, HTML content, and recipients.

subject.description: Email subject line shown to recipients.

htmlContent.description: HTML content of the email campaign body.

htmlUrl.description: URL of an HTML page to use as the campaign body.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime to schedule the campaign send.

listIds.description: List IDs to send the campaign to.

exclusionListIds.description: List IDs to exclude from the send.

emailCampaigns.send.title: Send Email Campaign Now
emailCampaigns.send.description: Immediately send a Brevo email campaign that is in draft or scheduled state.

campaignId.description: The numeric ID of the email campaign to send immediately.

emailCampaigns.get.title: Get Email Campaign
emailCampaigns.get.description: Retrieve details and statistics for a specific Brevo email campaign by its ID.

campaignId.description: The numeric ID of the email campaign to retrieve.

campaign_id.description: Id of the email campaign to retrieve details for.

statistics.description: Filter on the type of statistics required.

account.get.title: Get Account Information
account.get.description: Retrieve the authenticated Brevo account profile, plan credits, relay configuration, and marketing automation status.

companies.create.title: Create a company
companies.create.description: Create a Brevo CRM company with a name, optional attributes, country code, and linked contacts or deals.

name.description: Name of the company to create.

attributes.description: Custom company attributes such as domain, industry, owner, and address.

countryCode.description: Country calling code used when a phone_number attribute is supplied.

linkedDealsIds.description: Deal IDs to associate with the company.

linkedContactsIds.description: Contact IDs to associate with the company.

companies.get.title: Get Company Details
companies.get.description: Retrieve one Brevo CRM company by ID, including attributes and linked contact and deal IDs.

id.description: ID of the company to retrieve.

companies.delete.title: Delete a company
companies.delete.description: Permanently delete a Brevo CRM company by its unique identifier.

id.description: ID of the company to delete.

companies.list.title: List All Companies
companies.list.description: List Brevo CRM companies with pagination, sorting, attribute filters, and linked contact or deal filters.

page.description: Index of the first document of the page.

sortBy.description: Field used to sort results, for example createdAt or name.

filters.description: JSON object of attribute filters, for example {"attributes.name":"Company A"}.

linkedDealsIds.description: Filter companies linked to these deal IDs.

linkedContactsIds.description: Filter companies linked to these contact IDs.

smtp.templates.createOrUpdate.title: Create or Update Email Template
smtp.templates.createOrUpdate.description: Create a transactional email template, or update an existing template when templateId is supplied.

tag.description: Tag used to categorize the template.

sender.description: Sender identity with email and/or numeric sender id.

htmlUrl.description: Public URL of the HTML content. Use this or htmlContent, not both.

subject.description: Email subject. Required when creating a template.

toField.description: Personalization expression for the recipient To field.

isActive.description: Whether the template should be active.

templateId.description: ID of the template to update. Omit to create a new template.

templateName.description: Template name. Required when creating a template.

attachmentUrl.description: Absolute URL of a file to attach.

smtp.templates.delete.title: Delete Email Template
smtp.templates.delete.description: Delete an inactive transactional email template by numeric ID.

template_id.description: ID of the inactive template to delete.

smtp.templates.list.title: Get all email templates
smtp.templates.list.description: List transactional email templates with optional status filter, pagination, and sort order.

limit.description: Number of templates per page (default 50, max 1000).

offset.description: Index of the first template to return.

smtp.templates.get.title: Get Email Template
smtp.templates.get.description: Retrieve one transactional email template by numeric ID or custom identifier.

template_id.description: Numeric template ID or custom template identifier.

smsCampaigns.create.title: Create SMS Campaign
smsCampaigns.create.description: Create an SMS campaign with sender, content, optional recipients, and optional schedule.

sender.description: Sender name, up to 11 alphanumeric or 15 numeric characters.

content.description: SMS body. Segments are counted every 160 characters.

recipients.description: Included and excluded lists or segments.

scheduledAt.description: UTC date-time at which the campaign should run.

unicodeEnabled.description: Whether content should be treated as unicode.

organisationPrefix.description: Brand prefix added before the message content.

unsubscribeInstruction.description: STOP instructions appended after the message content.

smsCampaigns.delete.title: Delete SMS Campaign
smsCampaigns.delete.description: Delete an existing SMS campaign by numeric ID.

campaign_id.description: ID of the SMS campaign to delete.

smsCampaigns.get.title: Get SMS Campaign Details
smsCampaigns.get.description: Retrieve one SMS campaign including status, content, sender, schedule, recipients, and statistics.

campaign_id.description: ID of the SMS campaign to retrieve.

smsCampaigns.list.title: Get SMS Campaigns
smsCampaigns.list.description: List SMS campaigns with optional status, date, pagination, and sort filters.

offset.description: Index of the first campaign to return.

endDate.description: Ending UTC date-time used with startDate to filter sent campaigns.

startDate.description: Starting UTC date-time used with endDate to filter sent campaigns.

contacts.campaignStats.get.title: Get Contact Campaign Stats
contacts.campaignStats.get.description: Retrieve a contact's email campaign statistics for an optional bounded date range of at most 90 days.

identifier.description: Email address or numeric ID of the contact. The value is URL-encoded before it is sent.

start_date.description: Start of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be provided with end_date.

end_date.description: End of the statistics range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be provided with start_date.

contacts.import.title: Import Contacts
contacts.import.description: Submit a contact import from a public file URL, CSV body, or JSON rows. A 202 response returns the background process ID.

file_url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL of a .txt, .csv, or .json import file.

file_body.description: CSV content to import. Use semicolons to separate attributes.

json_body.description: Contact rows to import as JSON.

list_ids.description: Existing list IDs to import into. Supply this or new_list, not both.

list_name.description: Name of the list to create.

folder_id.description: Folder ID that will own the new list.

notify_url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL Brevo will call when the import finishes.

sms_blacklist.description: Whether to blacklist every imported contact for SMS.

email_blacklist.description: Whether to blacklist every imported contact for email.

consent_group_ids.description: Consent group IDs to attach to imported contacts.

disable_notification.description: Whether to disable the import email notification.

update_existing_contacts.description: Whether existing contacts should be updated. Defaults to true on the provider.

empty_contacts_attributes.description: Whether empty imported fields erase existing attributes.

contacts.attributes.list.title: List Contact Attributes
contacts.attributes.list.description: List the contact attributes configured on the authenticated Brevo account.

crm.notes.list.title: List CRM Notes
crm.notes.list.description: List one page of Brevo CRM notes, optionally filtered by entity type, entity IDs, and millisecond date range.

limit.description: Number of notes to request. Brevo defaults to 50.

entity.description: Entity type whose notes should be returned.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first note to return.

date_to.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for the end of the date range.

date_from.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for the start of the date range.

entity_ids.description: Entity ID filter as a single string accepted by Brevo.

crm.objects.records.list.title: List Custom Object Records
crm.objects.records.list.description: List one page of records for an Enterprise-only custom object type. The standard contact object is not supported.

object_type.description: Previously created custom object type whose records should be returned.

limit.description: Number of records per page (0-1000). Use 0 to retrieve only the total count.

association.description: Whether to include associated records (at most five per association).

senders.list.title: Get All Senders
senders.list.description: List verified email senders, optionally filtered by dedicated IP or domain.

ip.description: Filter senders for a dedicated IP. Available for dedicated-IP accounts only.

domain.description: Filter senders for a specific domain.

senders.domains.list.title: List Sender Domains
senders.domains.list.description: List sender domains and their authentication and verification status.

smtp.events.list.title: List Transactional Email Events
smtp.events.list.description: List one page of transactional email events with Brevo's complete filter set. Date selectors cannot exceed 90 days.

days.description: Number of past days to include, including today (1-90). Cannot be combined with start_date or end_date.

tags.description: Serialized tag array accepted by Brevo.

email.description: Return events for this recipient email address only.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (0-5000).

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first event to return.

end_date.description: End of an explicit report range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

message_id.description: Return events for this exact Brevo message ID.

start_date.description: Start of an explicit report range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

template_id.description: Return events generated from this template ID only.

emailCampaigns.update.title: Update Email Campaign
emailCampaigns.update.description: Update an existing email campaign by ID, including content, schedule, recipients, and A/B or IP-warmup settings.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign to update.

params.description: Template attributes used to personalize a New Template Language campaign.

sender.description: Sender identity with email and/or numeric sender id.

htmlUrl.description: URL of the HTML content. Mutually exclusive with htmlContent.

recurring.description: Allow contacts to receive a trigger campaign more than once.

recipients.description: Included and excluded lists or segments.

htmlContent.description: Inline HTML content. Mutually exclusive with htmlUrl.

winnerDelay.description: Hours before selecting the A/B winner.

initialQuota.description: Initial daily quota for IP warmup.

mirrorActive.description: Whether to include a browser mirror link.

sendAtBestTime.description: Let Brevo choose each recipient's best sending time.

winnerCriteria.description: Metric used to choose the winning A/B variant.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Brevo connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.
